candidate_change: The wallpaper catalog library is not injected any more.  WallpaperKit never looked for a catalog while it was there (v242, v243), and those are the first boots in which the render server draws in software at 1206x2622 instead of 1440x3200 (v237 to v243: native frames).  Whether the frame size returns to native is to be read from the first swaps of this image.

A log capture library (libpong-logcap-v244) is in SpringBoard, backboardd, PosterBoard, CollectionsPoster, PowerUIAgent, Freeform and kbd: it switches libsystem_trace to mirroring os_log to the process's error output (the environment variable OS_ACTIVITY_DT_MODE did nothing for wifid on 2026-11-27), filters it and passes it on through the kernel's diagnostic channel; for Freeform and kbd it keeps the last lines and passes them on when the process is about to die.

The Wi-Fi daemon's own library (libpong-wifid-v244) sets the same switch when it releases the daemon and keeps its output for the life of the process; the probe (libpong-probe-v244) samples wifid's threads.
Every library the injected libraries load is compared with the names Apple's own binaries use.

Carried unchanged: the firmware LUN check with the primary table deciding (v243), the retries and the record of a failed check (v242), the interface-namer marker and the en0 listing in configd (Settings -> About), the panic record slot (v238), the Settings hang dump with symbols (v238), protection classes A and B open for every process and IOSurface selector 21 (v237), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed.
